group.title: Field-trial feedback
group.passage:
To: Field-trial participants

Thank you for testing our new handheld scanner. Please submit your feedback by March 20, even if you did not [131] ____ any problems. Reports of normal operation help us compare results across different workplaces.

If an error occurs, note the time and the action you were performing. A screenshot may also be useful, [132] ____ it does not reveal customer information. [133] ____

Please do not install unofficial software on the trial device. Such changes could make the test results [134] ____. The support team can collect diagnostic logs if further investigation is needed.
group.passageZh:
收件者：現場試用參加者

感謝測試我們的新手持掃描器。即使沒有 [131] ____ 任何問題，也請最遲於三月二十日提交回饋。正常運作的報告有助比較不同工作場所的結果。

若發生錯誤，請記錄時間及當時進行的操作。截圖也可能有幫助，[132] ____ 不會洩露客戶資訊。[133] ____

請勿在試用設備安裝非官方軟體。這類變更可能讓測試結果 [134] ____。若需要進一步調查，支援團隊可以收集診斷紀錄。
